scientific_scope.problem: The rejected one-hop completion had only local canonical adjacency, not object-level cross-view correspondence.
scientific_scope.candidate: Build a source-only object memory by projecting a legal reference object anchor into training views, extracting fixed-box official SAM3 proposals from source RGB, and lifting those proposals back into primitive membership and region tokens.
scientific_scope.strict_query_boundary: Target inference reads only the sealed primitive region memory, sealed region tokens, and frozen canonical field. It must not open target RGB, target masks, or target metrics.
scientific_scope.benchmark_generality: The core accepts both positive-negative scribbles and a reference binary full mask, so the same method can serve NVOS and SPIn without a benchmark-specific operator.

fixed_method_contract.reference_anchor: official source/reference object mask with legal positive and negative prompt anchors retained
fixed_method_contract.projection_carrier: existing frozen query-independent raster_gaussian_top1 alpha_depth source-view responsibility
fixed_method_contract.source_view_selection: exclude reference and every forbidden target identity, then take top 3 by positive-anchor coverage times assignment reliability; deterministic frame-id tie break

sam3_box_policy.candidate_selection: maximum overlap with projected anchor; official score then candidate index only break overlap ties

fixed_method_contract.proposal_evidence_domain: the projected-anchor padded box, not the entire image
fixed_method_contract.primitive_membership_confidence: one minus exp of negative accumulated visible evidence mass
fixed_method_contract.hard_anchor_policy: legal positive and negative reference anchors overwrite pooled memory bitwise
fixed_method_contract.region_token_set: one normalized positive-proposal-weighted canonical field token per accepted source view plus the reference token

source_only_projection_smoke.claim_boundary: Planning smoke from the frozen binary reference completion and assignment carrier. Final frame identities must be sealed by the unchanged registered coarse producer before SAM3 and cannot be hard-coded from this diagnostic.

mapping_bug_prevented.finding: Responsibility assignment indices are dataset-local RADIO frame indices, not manifest training-list positions.
mapping_bug_prevented.fern: The two orders happen to agree after target exclusion.
mapping_bug_prevented.trex: The orders materially differ: manifest training frames are lexicographic, while RADIO uses numeric_then_exact. For example assignment view 0 is DJI_20200223_163553_010, not the first manifest training row DJI_20200223_163548_810.
mapping_bug_prevented.fix: The sealed inventory uses RADIO frame_manifest as the only assignment-index-to-RGB order authority, then verifies its unordered source set exactly equals the strict manifest training set and its excluded image set exactly equals the target set.
mapping_bug_prevented.test: A synthetic mismatched-order case passes with correct frame_manifest mapping; injecting a target filename into the source sequence fails before the target file exists or can be opened.

official_sam3_reuse.reuse_boundary: Reuse the official loader, autocast, normalized cxcywh box call, and overlap/official-score selector. Do not reuse LERF target-RGB receipt schemas or evaluator logic.

cost_estimate.avoided_exact_w_disk: approximately 7-9 GB for six native-resolution views
cost_estimate.expected_new_output_disk: less than 50 MB for six coarse/proposal masks, receipts, q/c tensors, and region tokens
cost_estimate.official_sam3_materialization_wall_clock: approximately 2-5 minutes on GPU1 including cold load for six source images

next_gate.required_before_launch: Implement and test the no-clobber coarse receipt plus official-SAM3 source-only bridge against this sealed inventory; then preregister the exact producer hashes and sentinel metric gate.
